story: The stage saw many attacks and a high pace, but no breakaway in the first two hours. A group of five escaped before the Ucka climb, with Kämna dominating it. After the descent, Kämna led but was caught by a chasing group, with De Gendt taking the virtual leader’s jersey for a few moments, before Bahrain, Caja Rural, Euskaltel and Cofidis started chasing. Martinez won the final sprint after Maisonobe bridged to the front.
